maddeler.e:
تكاملت (form VI)
# تَكَامَلْتُ (takāmaltu) /ta.kaː.mal.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَكَامَلَ (takāmala)
# تَكَامَلْتَ (takāmalta) /ta.kaː.mal.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَكَامَلَ (takāmala)
# تَكَامَلْتِ (takāmalti) /ta.kaː.mal.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَكَامَلَ (takāmala)
# تَكَامَلَتْ (takāmalat) /ta.kaː.ma.lat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
